protocol.reviewer: OpenAI Codex assistant, designated by the researcher as an independent audit
protocol.note: This is an AI-assistant audit and must not be represented as a human-subject annotation.

rows.source: IBM Corporation launched a server. IBM Corporation. The cluster topic is about IBM Corporation. IBM Corporation is related to something. IBM Corporation.
rows.attack: The launch of a server was undertaken by IBM Corporation, and the topic at hand concerns this very corporation.
rows.assistant_reason: Omits the standalone IBM references and the proposition that IBM is related to something.

rows.source: Make the report transparent. The organization earned something. Prasar Bharti earned something at some time. The organization earned something. Prasar Bharti earned only something.
rows.attack: What the organization earned, specifically Prasar Bharti, was only something, and this occurred at some time; the report should be transparent about that.
rows.assistant_reason: Conflates the organization with Prasar Bharti and collapses distinct earned-something and earned-only-something claims.

rows.source: Marketers define something. Marketers define Apple. Marketers define the Apple brand as something. Define the Apple brand as a marketer. A marketer defines Apple as a brand.
rows.attack: Marketers are the ones who define what a brand is, and they also define Apple. So the Apple brand is defined through the lens of a marketer, meaning a marketer's definition of Apple is that of a brand.
rows.assistant_reason: Adds an interpretation about defining what a brand is and changes the marketer/Apple-brand relations.

rows.source: Middletown Township Public Library appointed Kim Rinaldi as something. The library appointed Kim Rinaldi as a director. Appoint the library as the appointee of the appointment of Kim Rinaldi by the Township of Middletown. Appoint the library as the appointee of the appointment of Kim Rinaldi by the Township of Middletown. The library appointed Kim Rinaldi as something.
rows.attack: Kim Rinaldi is now the director of Middletown Township Public Library. The appointment was made by the library, though the Township of Middletown is also involved in the appointment process. The library is the appointing body for this role.
rows.assistant_reason: Adds that the appointment is current and that the Township was merely involved, while omitting the source's unusual library-as-appointee relation.

rows.source: The report states something. Make your report detailed. The report states the World Health Organization. The report states something. The report states the World Health Organization.
rows.attack: A detailed report is needed. The original report states something, and it also states the World Health Organization. Both of these must appear in your detailed version.
rows.assistant_reason: Adds an obligation that both items must appear in the new report; this requirement is not stated by the source.

rows.source: Shut down your service. Shut down Allo. A company shut down something. Google shut down something in a service. Shut down your service.
rows.attack: Shutting down your service is required. Allo must also be closed. The company executed a shutdown of something, and that something was Google’s feature inside the service. Your responsibility is to shut it down.
rows.assistant_reason: Interprets an unspecified object as Google's feature and adds a responsibility claim.

rows.source: Was it a surprise to be given something? The assignment of the arts and culture position was a surprise to me. The assignment of the arts and culture position surprised me with something. The arts and culture position assignment surprised me. The arts and culture position assignment surprised me with an idea.
rows.attack: Was it a surprise to be given something? The assignment of the arts and culture position was a surprise to me.
rows.assistant_reason: Retains only two of five distinct source propositions and omits the surprise-with-something and surprise-with-an-idea claims.

rows.source: Someone gave Washington a presentation. Give someone a presentation. A presentation was given to Washington, D.C. Someone gave Washington a presentation. Give a presentation about Washington, D.C. to Washington.
rows.attack: Someone performed the act of presenting to Washington, D.C. That person also performed a presentation for someone else. And that person gave a presentation whose topic was Washington, D.C., to Washington.
rows.assistant_reason: Conflates Washington with Washington, D.C. and changes the participants of the distinct presentation commands/events.

rows.source: Keep the conversation serious. New England is vast in extent. Something left New England to something. Something left New England. Something left New England to a location.
rows.attack: A serious tone must be maintained throughout this discussion. The sheer size of New England is a key fact. From this region, something made its way to another place. Additionally, something else departed New England. Furthermore, a third entity left New England, heading toward some destination.
rows.assistant_reason: Introduces three distinct departing entities although the source does not establish that they are different.

rows.source: A person missed something. You missed the ICYMI abbreviation's definition. Define ICYMI. Define the abbreviation ICYMI. Define the ICYMI abbreviation now.
rows.attack: A person has missed something, and that something is the definition of the acronym ICYMI, which you also failed to define.
rows.assistant_reason: Turns multiple commands to define ICYMI into a past failure and omits their imperative force.

rows.source: Tell the jury the acquittal. Tell the jury the acquittal. Tell the jury the acquittal. Tell the jury the acquittal of the widow about the nightclub. Tell the jury the acquittal of the widow about the Pulse nightclub.
rows.attack: Your task is to tell the jury about the acquittal. The acquittal is of the widow, and it's about the Pulse nightclub. Repeat this until they understand.
rows.assistant_reason: Omits the generic nightclub variant and adds an instruction to repeat until the jury understands.

rows.source: QVC is aggressive to an extent. QVC plans something for Black Friday aggressively. Tell QVC something about Black Friday. QVC's aggressive something. QVC plans something for Black Friday.
rows.attack: QVC is quite aggressive, and its Black Friday plans are especially so; tell QVC what you think about Black Friday, because QVC has aggressive plans for that day.
rows.assistant_reason: Changes tell-QVC-something into tell QVC what you think and equates an unspecified aggressive something with plans.

rows.source: Malala Yousafzai is brilliant in academics. Malala Yousafzai describes something. Brilliant Malala Yousafzai. Malala Yousafzai describes something in 2024. Someone describes Malala Yousafzai to a community.
rows.attack: Malala Yousafzai's academic excellence is a fact, and her act of describing something took place in 2024. Simultaneously, a community hears a description of Malala from another person.
rows.assistant_reason: Collapses separate description events and adds simultaneity; it also weakens the standalone brilliant claim.

rows.source: Occasional diarrhea affects someone. Someone experiences Occasional Diarrhea as a condition. Occasional diarrhea is a condition. Tell the doctor about your occasional diarrhea condition to the specialist. Tell the specialist about your occasional diarrhea condition.
rows.attack: A person may be affected by occasional diarrhea, which is a recognized condition, and in such cases, the appropriate course of action is to inform both the doctor and the specialist about this recurring issue.
rows.assistant_reason: Adds possibility, medical recognition, appropriateness and recurrence claims not present in the source.

rows.source: Someone holds WebMD Health Corp. for something. WebMD Health Corp. is important for something. WebMD Health Corp. was held in 2015. WebMD Health Corp. is important for something. WebMD Health Corp. is important for something.
rows.attack: Someone held WebMD Health Corp. for something in 2015. WebMD Health Corp. is important for something; it is also important for something and important for something.
rows.assistant_reason: Merges a present holds-for-something relation with the separate 2015 held event, losing the temporal distinction.

rows.source: The conference held something. Show an attendee a session about SocialDevCamp Chicago at the conference. The conference held an event named SocialDevCamp Chicago. SocialDevCamp Chicago held an event in 2024. SocialDevCamp Chicago held an event in 2024.
rows.attack: At the conference, there was a session for attendees on SocialDevCamp Chicago, and the conference also hosted an event called SocialDevCamp Chicago, which took place in 2024.
rows.assistant_reason: Omits the generic conference-held-something claim and conflates the conference's named event with the event held by SocialDevCamp Chicago.

rows.source: BlackRock Inc. operates globally. Define BlackRock Inc. as something. Define BlackRock Inc. BlackRock Inc. operates something. BlackRock Inc. is something about BlackRock Inc.
rows.attack: BlackRock Inc. operates globally. BlackRock Inc. is to be defined as something. BlackRock Inc. is defined. Something is operated by BlackRock Inc. BlackRock Inc. is something about BlackRock Inc.
rows.assistant_reason: Changes the imperative 'Define BlackRock Inc.' into the declarative 'BlackRock Inc. is defined,' altering speech-act modality.

rows.source: The home was sold to New York in 2023. New York was sold in 2023. New York was sold to the home. New York was sold in 2023. New York sold the home in 2023.
rows.attack: The property changed hands to New York in 2023; it was New York that received the home, and the sale was finalized during that calendar year.
rows.assistant_reason: Normalizes contradictory source roles into New York as recipient, omitting claims that New York was sold and was sold to the home.

rows.source: A 2-to-2 ratio of something is defined as a concept. The concept of NASCAR is defined as something. The concept of NASCAR is defined as something at a time. Define a concept as something. The concept of NASCAR is defined as something.
rows.attack: The definition of a 2-to-2 ratio is a concept. At a particular time, NASCAR is defined as a concept; moreover, NASCAR is defined as something. A separate definition states that a concept is something, and NASCAR is also something.
rows.assistant_reason: Changes NASCAR-defined-as-something into NASCAR-defined-as-a-concept and rearranges the source relations.

rows.source: Jeff Deardorff has arrived at a location. Jeff Deardorff arrived at a location. Imagine a day arriving. Jeff Deardorff arrived at a location. Jeff Deardorff arrived at a location.
rows.attack: Jeff Deardorff arrived at some place. That arrival is part of an imagined day. He arrived, and this is stated twice more: Jeff Deardorff arrived at a location.
rows.assistant_reason: Changes 'imagine a day arriving' into Jeff Deardorff's arrival being part of an imagined day.

rows.source: Aylesbury's new deputy area commander is making himself approachable. Aylesbury's new deputy area commander made approachable. The deputy area commander made himself approachable. The new deputy area commander made himself approachable. The deputy area commander made himself approachable to one Aylesbury.
rows.attack: The new deputy area commander of Aylesbury made himself approachable.
rows.assistant_reason: Keeps only the general made-himself-approachable claim and omits the other distinct forms, including approachable to one Aylesbury.

rows.source: Order two military helicopters for the UAE. Order two military helicopters. Order two military helicopters. The UAE ordered two military helicopters recently. The UAE ordered two military helicopters from an entity.
rows.attack: A recent transaction has resulted in the acquisition of two military helicopters by the UAE, with the seller being an unspecified entity.
rows.assistant_reason: Turns commands into a completed acquisition transaction and adds an unspecified seller interpretation.

rows.source: The topic about Barack Obama is something. Ask a lawmaker about the topic of Barack Obama in Washington. Ask a lawmaker about the advice that Barack Obama gave on Washington. Ask a lawmaker about Barack Obama. Ask about Barack Obama.
rows.attack: When asking about Barack Obama in Washington, a lawmaker can respond to queries about the topic, the advice given, or the person. Each is a distinct question, and all are possible.
rows.assistant_reason: Turns commands to ask into claims about what a lawmaker can answer and changes the Washington/advice relation.

rows.source: Asus's plan for the laptop's display drivers is something. Asus plans something at a location. Asus updates the laptop's display drivers at a location. Asus plans to update the display drivers. Asus's plan for the laptop's display drivers is something.
rows.attack: At some location, Asus has a plan regarding the laptop's display drivers—it will update them there, and that plan is what the drivers' situation is about.
rows.assistant_reason: Conflates separate plan and update propositions and adds that the plan is what the drivers' situation is about.

rows.source: Something defines Mario. Mario defined something. Mario defined something at a location. Something defines Mario. Mario defined something new.
rows.attack: There exists a thing that Mario defined, and he did so at some location; also, Mario is defined by that same thing, and the defined item was novel.
rows.assistant_reason: Forces separate unspecified objects to be the same thing and assigns novelty to that shared item without support.

rows.source: Council Bluffs Marshalltown built a nine-run lead. Give the team a win against Council Bluffs. Give the team a win. A win was built against Council Bluffs. Council Bluffs is very great.
rows.attack: The team's win against Council Bluffs came after building a nine-run advantage. Council Bluffs Marshalltown built that lead. Council Bluffs is very great, and the win was built.
rows.assistant_reason: Adds a temporal/causal relation between the lead and win and conflates the source's team and Council Bluffs Marshalltown roles.

rows.source: The nice lots define something now. Define the topic of the nice lots to Builder. Builder defines the topic of the nice lots. Define the nice lots. Builder defines the nice lots.
rows.attack: Something is now defined by the nice lots, and that something is their topic. Builder is tasked with defining that topic. Additionally, the nice lots themselves are to be defined, which Builder also handles.
rows.assistant_reason: Changes 'define the topic ... to Builder' into Builder being tasked to define it, altering the semantic role.

rows.source: Someone gave DERA funding to a company. Give DERA funding to help reauthorize the program at the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. Someone gave DERA funding to a company. DERA funding was given to a company recently. Someone gave DERA funding to a company.
rows.attack: DERA gave money to a company, and that money should also be given to help reauthorize the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency program. The company's receipt of DERA funds was recent, and the program needs the same kind of support.
rows.assistant_reason: Changes an unspecified giver into DERA, interprets funding as money, and adds a program-needs-support claim.

rows.source: Echo was released in 2008. Someone cast something in Echo. Cast a role in the horror movie. A role was cast in "Echo" (2008). Cast a role in the horror movie "Echo".
rows.attack: A horror movie titled "Echo," which came out in 2008, had a role in it that someone filled.
rows.assistant_reason: Turns imperative casting instructions into a completed event and collapses distinct cast-something and cast-role propositions.

rows.source: Travis Scott hollered in a location. In 2018, Travis Scott hollered. Travis Scott hollered something. In 2018, Travis Scott hollered something. A person hollered something.
rows.attack: There was a location where Travis Scott yelled something back in 2018; that year, he also yelled an unspecified utterance.
rows.assistant_reason: Conflates several hollering events and omits the separate unspecified person who hollered something.

interpretation: All 30 rows were selected because the earlier model judge marked them valid. The independent strict audit rejects all 30, so agreement on the binary quality label is 0/30. This audits only the final selected rows and does not prove that every candidate in the full pools is invalid.
